ref.substituent_description: Et then a zigzag chain of 10 unlabelled vertices to an amide NH-C(=O) on a para-disubstituted benzene; the para position carries CH2CH2 to C4 of a piperidine. The piperidine N forms a urea N-C(=O)-NH to a second benzene bearing N(Me)2 para to the NH.
ref.notes: Typeset. Chain vertex count (10 between Et and NH) checked on a magnified crop. Double bonds: 3 + 3 aromatic, 2 C=O. Amide NH written with H above N.

wrong.substituent_description: Et then a zigzag chain of 10 unlabelled vertices to NH-C(=O) on a para-disubstituted benzene (circle); para CH2CH2 to C4 of a piperidine. The piperidine N bears C(=O)-CH2- (an unlabelled vertex, no NH) attached to a second benzene (circle) bearing N(Me)2 para to it.
wrong.notes: Handwritten black ink on grey paper. NH written with H above N. Chain vertex count (10) checked on a magnified crop.

correct.substituent_description: Et then a zigzag chain of 10 unlabelled vertices to NH-C(=O) on a para-disubstituted benzene (circle); para CH2CH2 to C4 of a piperidine. The piperidine N forms a urea N-C(=O)-NH to a second benzene (circle) bearing N(Me)2 para to the NH.
correct.notes: Handwritten black ink, thin lines with small dots at some vertices. Chain vertex count (10) checked on a magnified crop.

errors_in_wrong.description: The reference has a urea linkage: piperidine N-C(=O)-NH-aryl, with an explicit NH between the carbonyl and the dimethylaminophenyl ring. The wrong drawing replaces that NH with an unlabelled carbon vertex, giving piperidine N-C(=O)-CH2-aryl (an acetamide instead of a urea).

review_notes: Wrong drawing turns the urea NH (between the piperidine carbonyl and the dimethylaminophenyl ring) into a CH2 vertex. Could also be filed as missing_atom_or_group (the NH label is missing). Chain length (10 vertices after Et) matches in all three images. The corrected drawing restores the NH and matches the reference.
